insight: Motor current draw has risen 23% over 30 days with switching time averaging 5.8 s — consistent with early-stage gearbox bearing wear. Lubricant depletion accelerating.
recommended_action: Schedule gearbox lubrication and bearing inspection within 7 days (MAN-PM-002, Sec 6.2)

insight: Receiver voltage declining at 0.12 V/week with IRJ resistance approaching 1 MΩ threshold. Gradual impedance loss indicating joint insulation fatigue.
recommended_action: Schedule IRJ insulation replacement within 14 days (MAN-TC-001, Sec 2.3)

insight: Sustained vibration above 4.8 g with 3 count-discrepancy alarms in the past 7 days. Mounting bolt torque likely below specification.
recommended_action: Torque-check M10 mounting bolts to 25 Nm and re-verify alignment within 48 hours (MAN-AC-001, Sec 3.2)

insight: Switching time exceeded 6.5 s on 4 of the last 7 operations with irregular current spikes. Switch blade gap highly likely out of tolerance — Priority 1 defect.
recommended_action: Inspect and adjust switch blade gap before next service window. Priority 1 if gap >4mm (MAN-PM-001, Sec 4.2)

insight: All telemetry within normal bounds. Receiver voltage stable at 2.1 V with no threshold breaches across 30 days of monitoring.
recommended_action: Continue standard monitoring cadence. Next scheduled inspection per 6-month calendar.

insight: 5 count-discrepancy alarms in 10 days with sensor alignment within tolerance — strongly indicates junction box moisture ingress. Urgent seal integrity check required.
recommended_action: Inspect junction box for moisture, dry and reseal. Replace sensor head if discrepancies persist (MAN-AC-002, Sec 7.2)

insight: Point machine operating nominally. Switching times consistent at 4.2–4.5 s with stable current draw across all 30 days of telemetry.
recommended_action: No action required. Maintain standard inspection schedule.

insight: Receiver voltage dropped sharply from 1.8 V to 1.1 V over 5 days — pattern consistent with ballast fouling or vegetation ingress. Voltage now below 1.2 V safety threshold.
recommended_action: Immediate visual ballast inspection and vegetation clearance (MAN-TC-002, Sec 5.1)

insight: Vibration and count accuracy within acceptable range. Asset approaching late-life phase — increase inspection frequency per standard 10-year overhaul protocol.
recommended_action: Initiate 10-year service check per manufacturer guidelines. Review for mid-life overhaul scheduling.

insight: No anomalies detected. Switching performance nominal across all 30 days of telemetry with consistent 4.3 s switching times.
recommended_action: No action required. Next scheduled inspection per maintenance calendar.

insight: Track circuit operating within full specification. Voltage and impedance readings stable with no anomalies detected over the monitoring window.
